title: Flight Compartment Wiring — Cockpit Panel Harnesses, Captain Side

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Wiring diagram for the captain side cockpit panel harnesses, covering the side console feeds, the panel bus bar and the equipment that draws from it including the flight deck information installation.

sections.purpose: Wiring diagram of the captain side cockpit panel harnesses, from the panel bus bar to the side console and glareshield equipment.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn looking inboard from the captain seat position. The panel bus bar at the centre of the sheet feeds every item on this diagram and is the point at which a whole-panel loss is isolated. The side console branch shown at the lower right carries the flight deck information equipment feed, which was extended when the ventilated mounting arm was introduced; the extended run has its own clamp positions and the earlier route is shown greyed. Equipment fed from the first officer bus bar is not shown here.
sections.routing_note: The console branch runs from the panel bus bar down the seat track channel and forward along the console floor to the arm base. The service loop at the arm base is deliberate and must not be shortened; the arm swings through its full travel and a short loop pulls the connector. The branch crosses no hydraulic line and is not co-routed with any high energy feed.
